components.note: 日 (sun) — marks sun, daylight and time, as in 明 bright, 晚 evening, 早 early; 晒 is drying or basking in the sun.
西 (xī) — loose sound hint (shài vs xī); same part in 洒 sǎ.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 呜 imitates sobbing or a whistle.
乌 (wū) — same sound: 呜 wū. 乌 means crow.
弓 (bow) — marks bows and bending, as in 张 stretch, 引 draw; 弯 is a curve, like a bent bow.
戈 (dagger-axe) — marks weapons and striking, as in 战 battle, 武 martial; 戳 is stabbing or poking.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 仙 is an immortal, a person of the mountains.
山 (mountain) — a person 亻 of the mountains 山: a hermit immortal, as in 神仙.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 芬 is fragrance from plants, as in 芬芳.
分 (fēn) — same sound: 芬 fēn. 分 also sounds out 纷 fēn and 氛 fēn.
讠 (speech; traditional 言) — marks speaking and language, as in 说 say, 话 speech, 请 request; 谜 is a riddle, words that puzzle.
迷 (mí) — same sound: 谜 mí. 迷 means lost, confused.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 磨 grind; 碟 is a small plate or dish.
枼 (yè) — close sound: 碟 dié. 枼 also sounds out 蝶 dié and 谍 dié.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 茱 is in the name of the dogwood plant, 茱萸.
朱 (zhū) — same sound: 茱 zhū. 朱 also sounds out 珠 zhū and 株 zhū.
串 (chuàn) — two pieces strung on a line 丨: a skewer or string, as in 羊肉串 lamb skewer and 一串 a string.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嚼 is chewing.
爵 (jué) — close sound: 嚼 jiáo/jué.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 垮 is collapsing, as earth does, as in 垮台.
夸 (kuā) — close sound: 垮 kuǎ. 夸 also sounds out 跨 kuà and 挎 kuà.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 掐 is pinching with the nails or choking.
臽 (xiàn) — loose sound hint (qiā); same part in 陷 xiàn and 馅 xiàn.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 洒 is sprinkling water.
西 (xī) — loose sound hint (sǎ vs xī); same part in 晒 shài.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 铜 copper; 铺 is a shop or a spread-out bed; once metal tiles on a door.
甫 (fǔ) — close sound: 铺 pū. 甫 also sounds out 捕 bǔ, 哺 bǔ and 辅 fǔ.
辶 (walk, 走之) — marks movement and roads, as in 过 pass, 进 enter, 送 send; 逊 is yielding, giving way, as in 谦逊 humble.
孙 (sūn) — close sound: 逊 xùn. 孙 means grandchild.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 挪 is shifting something by hand.
那 (nà) — close sound: 挪 nuó. 那 also sounds out 哪 nǎ and 娜 nuó.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 挨 is leaning on or being next to, and enduring, as in 挨打.
矣 (yǐ) — loose sound hint (āi vs yǐ); same part in 唉 āi and 埃 āi.
云 (cloud) — an old picture of swirling cloud; the rain-topped 雲 is the traditional form. Also the old word for say, as in 子曰诗云.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 垫 is a cushion or pad put underneath.
执 (zhí) — loose sound hint (diàn vs zhí).
饣 (food; traditional 食) — marks food and eating, as in 饭 meal, 饿 hungry, 饺 dumpling; 饶 is abundant, with plenty to eat, as in 丰饶; also to forgive 饶恕.
尧 (yáo) — close sound: 饶 ráo. 尧 also sounds out 烧 shāo and 晓 xiǎo.
王 (jade; 玉 form) — marks jewels and gems, as in 球 ball, 玩 play, 珠 pearl; 珀 is amber, as in 琥珀.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 灌 is pouring water to irrigate.
雚 (guàn) — same sound: 灌 guàn. 雚 also sounds out 罐 guàn and 观 guān.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 添 is adding more, as water is topped up.
忝 (tiǎn) — close sound: 添 tiān. 忝 also sounds out 舔 tiǎn.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 哩 is a particle; as a measure it is mile, as in 英哩.
里 (lǐ) — same sound: 哩 lǐ. 里 also sounds out 理 lǐ and 鲤 lǐ.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 铜 copper; 锅 is a pot or pan.
呙 (guō) — same sound: 锅 guō. 呙 also sounds out 蜗 wō and 窝 wō.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 磨 grind; 砰 imitates a bang, like stones striking.
平 (píng) — close sound: 砰 pēng. 平 also sounds out 苹 píng and 评 píng.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 坑 is a pit dug in the ground.
亢 (kàng) — close sound: 坑 kēng. 亢 also sounds out 抗 kàng and 航 háng.
⺼ (flesh, from 肉) — marks body parts, as in 肚 belly, 脸 face, 腿 leg; 胶 is glue, once made from animal tissue.
交 (jiāo) — same sound: 胶 jiāo. 交 also sounds out 校 xiào and 郊 jiāo.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness, as in 病 ill, 疼 pain, 痛 ache; 癖 is an ingrained habit or craving, as in 怪癖.
辟 (pì) — close sound: 癖 pǐ. 辟 also sounds out 僻 pì and 避 bì.
禾 (grain) — marks grain and crops, as in 种, 秋; 税 is tax, originally paid in grain.
兑 (duì) — loose sound hint (shuì); same part in 说 shuō and 脱 tuō.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 捏 is pinching or kneading.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 呗 is a sentence-final particle.
贝 (bèi) — close sound: 呗 bei. 贝 also sounds out 狈 bèi.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness, as in 病 ill, 疼 pain, 痛 ache; 痒 is itching.
羊 (yáng) — close sound: 痒 yǎng. 羊 also sounds out 洋 yáng and 样 yàng.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 浓 is thick, strong or dense, as in 浓茶.
农 (nóng) — same sound: 浓 nóng. 农 also sounds out 脓 nóng.
方 (square, direction) — in 旗 it marks flags and banners, as in 旅 travel, 族 clan; 旗 is a flag.
其 (qí) — same sound: 旗 qí. 其 also sounds out 期 qī and 棋 qí.
⺼ (flesh, from 肉) — marks body parts, as in 肚 belly, 脸 face, 腿 leg; 肾 is the kidney.
足 (foot) — marks feet and walking, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road; 蹦 is bouncing or jumping.
崩 (bēng) — close sound: 蹦 bèng. 崩 also sounds out 绷 bēng.
力 (strength) — 勃 is vigorous, as in 蓬勃 flourishing and 勃然 suddenly.
孛 (bèi) — close sound: 勃 bó. 孛 also sounds out 脖 bó.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 哄 is coaxing, or a din of voices, as in 哄堂大笑.
共 (gòng) — loose sound hint (hōng vs gòng); same part in 洪 hóng.
甘 (sweet) — a mouth 口 holding something 一 in it: a sweet taste, as in 甘甜, then willing, as in 甘愿.
灬 (fire) — marks fire and cooking, as in 煮 boil, 蒸 steam; 熏 is smoking or fumigating over a fire.
冫 (ice, 两点水) — marks cold and freezing, as in 冷 cold, 冰 ice, 决; 凑 is coming together; 冫 here is water, not ice.
奏 (zòu) — close sound: 凑 còu. 奏 also sounds out 揍 zòu.
禾 (grain) — a hand holding two stalks 禾禾: taking both at once, as in 兼职 side job and 兼顾 look after both.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 朴 is plain, unadorned, as in 朴素 simple.
卜 (bǔ) — close sound: 朴 pǔ. 卜 also sounds out 扑 pū.
